decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of the original permission on 05 May 2018.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Daylight and Sunlight Study, Design and Access Statement, 604.001, 604.101, 604.102 Received: 03 November 2014 Flood Risk Assessment, 604.211 Received: 08 December 2014 Forticrete Masonry Brochure, 604.200a Received: 24 February 2015 604.201b, 604.202b, 604.203b, 604.205c, 604.206b, 604.207b, Received: 17 March 2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 2015 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of the site shall be carried out.

Condition : 4 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as [74 Park Road, Chiswick W4 3HL].

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 8:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 7 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 9 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Flood Risk Assessment produced and provided with the application and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures in the Flood Risk Assessment are implemented.

Condition : 11 - The details contained in the Construction Method Statement as approved under planning ref 01255/74/P1(11,16) shall be implemented as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 12 - The details of the screen planting and maintenance report as approved under planning ref 01255/74/P1(12) shall be implemented as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing.
Condition : 13 - The basement area shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 14 - The details of materials and samples as approved under planning ref 01255/74/P1(11,16) shall be implemented as approved unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
description: Removal of conditions 13 & 14 (sustainable homes) of planning permission 01255/74/P1 dated 06/05/2015 for the demolition of an existing house and erection of a three storey detached house with basement, single storey garden pavilion with outbuilding to rear garden
